caption: The drawing depicts a tall wooden chest of drawers, often referred to as a highboy. The chest is composed of two main sections: the upper section has four drawers stacked vertically, while the lower section has three larger drawers. Each drawer is fitted with two ornate metal handles, and a keyhole is positioned at the center of each drawer. The highboy stands on four bracket feet, and the lower skirt features a shaped cut-out design. The wood has a medium brown hue with visible grain patterns throughout, giving the piece a textured appearance. The top of the highboy is adorned with an elaborate, curved pediment featuring three decorative finials—one in the center and one on each side. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no other objects or embellishments present.
title: Chest-on-Chest
